headline: Your website is up to date and secure.
summary: In May we updated Next.js and React, fixed three broken links and made the gallery 41% lighter, so it opens faster on phones.
improvementsNote: The main changes this month, each tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Next.js and React updated
improvements.body: Both frameworks moved to their latest stable releases, with security fixes.

improvements.title: Broken links on Work page fixed
improvements.body: Three project links pointed to missing pages. All three now open correctly.

improvements.title: Gallery images compressed
improvements.body: Gallery photos are 41% lighter, so the page opens faster on phones.

improvements.title: Weekly log review in place
improvements.body: We now read the server logs every week and act on anything unusual.

nextMonth: Fix the mobile menu so it closes after a link is tapped
Describe every gallery image for screen readers
Rewrite page titles and descriptions for search
